t: This is the home of Islam Channel, a British free-to-air satellite television channel and online platform, funded by advertising and donations. It began broadcasting in March 2004 and is in English, with an Urdu channel added in 2015. It broadcasts across Europe, the Middle East and Africa, and streams live online. It was founded by Mohamed Ali Harrath, a Tunisian activist and businessman, who owned it. His son, Mohamed Harrath, is now its chief executive.
